Main causes of repeated bans:
- No warmup on new numbers (Meta fingerprints sudden volume spikes)
- No jitter — fixed-interval sends are bot signatures
- No session health monitoring (degradation before ban = catchable signal)

[`baileys-antiban`](https://github.com/kobie3717/baileys-antiban) wraps your existing Baileys socket with all three. 7-day warmup ramp, Gaussian jitter, health monitor with auto-pause. One-line wrapper, no rewrite needed. Free/MIT.

```bash
npm install baileys-antiban
```
